text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Angelfish and corydoras. There's such a wide variety... I can't help but stare.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Still, why is it...
Something feels slightly off today—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
! This freshwater snail—is it less active than usual?
I hope it's just my imagination...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Worried about the safety of the tiny seashell, Admire Groove was left feeling uneasy.
